name: tsa_getMenuItems
description: Returns every TSA.MenuItem for a restaurant, ordered by name, including items with isAvailable = 0 (the caller filters). Public data; called by GET. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'getMenuItems' to [TSA].[tsa_getMenuItems]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

rowsets.name: MenuItems
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows ordered by name (zero rows → shim 404, which the client treats as empty).

columns.name: isAvailable
columns.description: BIT column: serialised by the shim as a JSON boolean.

codeSmells.detail: @restaurantId (line 2) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.
TSA.MenuItem.isAvailable is BIT (CLAUDE.md: never BIT); it reaches the client as true/false.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
